title: Think Right, Not More: Test-Time Scaling for Numerical Claim Verification
authors_zh: Primakov Chungkham、Venktesh V、Vinay Setty、Avishek Anand（机构：TU Delft、Stockholm University、University of Stavanger）
paper_type_zh: 自适应验证器引导的测试时扩展研究（Findings of EMNLP 2025）
best_for_zh: 为证据支撑的非数学决策分配推理预算的读者。
one_line: VerifierFC uses claim complexity to decide when to sample multiple fact-checking paths and a process verifier to select among them.
VerifierFC 按声明复杂度决定何时采样多条核查路径，并用过程验证器从中选择。
why: It shows that selective expansion can outperform uniform expansion when verification difficulty varies sharply by instance.
inclusion_reason: It selectively allocates multi-path inference and verifier selection to complex claims, directly changing the test-time compute policy.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Real-world numerical claims often combine amounts, dates, units, and several pieces of evidence. A language model can begin on a sound path yet drift when it overinterprets a different currency, an auxiliary detail, or apparently conflicting evidence. One-shot fact checking therefore fails not only because retrieval is noisy, but because a single reasoning trajectory may backtrack away from a correct interpretation.

The paper asks whether multiple inference-time reasoning paths can reduce this drift, and whether every claim deserves the same expensive expansion. It seeks a policy that samples and verifies alternatives for difficult claims while avoiding waste on straightforward ones. The target is evidence-grounded verdict selection, where extra computation is guided by both path quality and predicted claim complexity.

现实数值声明常同时包含金额、日期、单位和多份证据。语言模型可能一开始走在可靠路径上，却因过度解释另一种货币、辅助细节或看似冲突的证据而偏离。一次性事实核查失败不仅因为检索有噪声，也因为单条推理轨迹可能从正确解释回退。

论文追问多条推理时路径能否减少这种偏移，以及每个声明是否都值得同样昂贵的扩展。它寻求一种策略：对困难声明采样并验证替代方案，同时避免在简单声明上浪费计算。目标是基于证据选择裁决，其中额外计算同时由路径质量与预测的声明复杂度引导。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method combines two decisions. First, it generates several reasoning paths for a claim and lets a process verifier score the plausibility of each path together with its verdict. This replaces a simple majority over labels with a selection rule that can prefer a minority answer supported by a more coherent evidence analysis.

Second, it predicts whether a claim is complex enough to merit the multi-path procedure. Complexity is estimated from layer-wise latent representations and corresponds to whether decomposition is needed to verify the claim. The intended result is selective test-time scaling: simple claims receive a cheaper path, while multi-aspect numerical claims receive a larger exploration-and-verification budget.

方法结合两项决策。第一，它为一个声明生成若干推理路径，并让过程验证器对每条路径及其裁决的可信度评分。这取代了对标签做简单多数投票，使选择规则能偏好虽然处于少数、却由更连贯证据分析支持的答案。

第二，它预测一个声明是否复杂到值得使用多路径程序。复杂度从逐层潜在表示估计，并对应核查是否需要分解。预期结果是选择性测试时扩展：简单声明使用较便宜的路径，多方面数值声明获得更大的探索与验证预算。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline retrieves evidence with BM25 and reranking, then samples multiple claim-verification paths from an LLM. VERIFIERFC is trained on claim, path, and predicted verdict triples, using both paths whose verdict matches expert labels and paths whose verdict does not. At inference, the verifier scores the paths and the highest-scored path supplies the selected verdict.

For adaptive scaling, the system estimates claim complexity from layer-wise latent representations using a semi-supervised decomposition signal. Rather than applying Best-of-N uniformly, it allocates the more expensive verifier-guided search to claims predicted to require it. This ties the stored objects—claim, evidence, paths, scores, complexity, and verdict—to a direct budget decision for every test instance.

流程先用 BM25 和重排序检索证据，再从语言模型采样多条声明核查路径。VERIFIERFC 在声明、路径和预测裁决三元组上训练，同时使用裁决匹配专家标签的路径和不匹配的路径。推理时，验证器为路径评分，最高分路径提供被选裁决。

对于自适应扩展，系统使用半监督的分解信号，从逐层潜在表示估计声明复杂度。它不对所有声明统一应用最佳候选，而是把更昂贵的验证器引导搜索分配给预测需要它的声明。这将所存对象——声明、证据、路径、分数、复杂度和裁决——连接到每个测试实例的直接预算决策。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper reports that verifier-guided multi-path scaling mitigates the identified reasoning-drift failure on complex numerical claims. Its adaptive policy improves performance by 18.8 percent on QuanTemp and 21.27 percent on ClaimDecomp relative to single-shot methods, while reporting 1.8 times the computational efficiency of standard uniform test-time scaling.

The evidence is specific to evidence-based claim verification rather than general open-ended reasoning. It demonstrates that difficulty-sensitive allocation matters when claims vary in numerical and compositional complexity. A reviewer should inspect the retrieval quality, the verifier’s calibration, the complexity threshold, and the number of paths, because an apparent budget gain can move between these components rather than arise from one mechanism alone.

官方论文报告，验证器引导的多路径扩展可缓解复杂数值声明中识别出的推理偏移失效。其自适应策略相对一次性方法在 QuanTemp 上提升 18.8%、在 ClaimDecomp 上提升 21.27%，同时报告的计算效率是标准统一测试时扩展的 1.8 倍。

证据针对基于证据的声明核查，而非一般开放式推理。它证明当声明在数值和组合复杂性上不同，难度敏感的分配很重要。审阅者应检查检索质量、验证器校准、复杂度阈值和路径数，因为表面预算收益可能在这些部件之间转移，而非单独来自一种机制。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not only using a verifier for Best-of-N. It makes the decision to invoke Best-of-N itself conditional on an instance-level estimate of complexity. This creates a routing policy between a cheap one-path consumer and an expensive multi-path, verifier-selected consumer, so compute is part of the fact-checking decision rather than a fixed global setting.

The paper also frames reasoning drift as a failure that can occur despite relevant evidence and despite long reasoning. Multiple candidate paths are therefore not treated as a generic way to “think more,” but as alternatives from which a verifier can recover an evidence interpretation that one drifting path abandoned. This is a useful pattern for settings where correctness is evidence-grounded but not reducible to a simple executable test.

独特贡献不只是把验证器用于最佳候选。它使调用最佳候选本身的决策依赖实例级复杂度估计。这在便宜的单路径消费者与昂贵的多路径验证器选择消费者之间形成路由策略，因此计算是事实核查决策的一部分，而不是固定的全局设定。

论文还将推理偏移视为一种即使拥有相关证据、即使推理很长也会发生的失效。因此，多条候选路径不被当作笼统的“想得更多”，而是让验证器从中恢复一条被单一偏移路径放弃的证据解释。这对正确性基于证据、但不能简化为可执行测试的场景是有用模式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Performance depends on evidence retrieval, the definition of claim complexity, and the verifier’s ability to distinguish plausible but wrong paths; an error at any of these stages can misallocate compute or select a polished hallucination. Complexity derived from latent states may not transfer across base models or changing claim distributions. The paper evaluates reported fact-checking datasets and labels, so its gains should not be read as a guarantee for time-sensitive news, adversarial misinformation, or claims lacking retrievable evidence. The extra paths and verifier also add latency that must be measured in a deployed pipeline.
性能取决于证据检索、声明复杂度定义和验证器区分看似合理但错误路径的能力；其中任何阶段出错都可能错误分配计算或选择润色过的幻觉。由潜在状态得到的复杂度未必能在基础模型或变化的声明分布之间迁移。论文评估报告的事实核查数据集和标签，因此其收益不应被理解为对时效新闻、对抗性虚假信息或缺少可检索证据的声明的保证。额外路径和验证器也会增加延迟，必须在部署流程中测量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a fact-checking service must reserve costly multi-path reasoning for claims likely to need it. Log the retrieved evidence, predicted complexity, routing choice, sampled paths, verifier scores, verdict, token cost, and latency. Compare uniform Best-of-N, single-pass verification, and complexity-routed scaling with the same retrieval corpus. It is particularly useful for designing an escalation policy: a simple claim should not receive the same inference budget as a claim that requires reconciling dates, units, quantities, and multiple evidence sources.
当事实核查服务必须把昂贵的多路径推理留给可能需要它的声明时，可使用这篇论文。应记录检索到的证据、预测复杂度、路由选择、采样路径、验证器分数、裁决、词元成本和延迟。在相同检索语料下比较统一最佳候选、一次验证和复杂度路由扩展。它尤其适合设计升级策略：简单声明不应与需要协调日期、单位、数量和多份证据的声明获得同样的推理预算。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Audit the router and verifier separately. First measure whether the latent complexity classifier sends genuinely difficult claims to the expensive path; then measure whether the verifier selects a better trajectory than majority voting from the identical candidate pool. Retrieval must be frozen when comparing the selection policy, otherwise improved evidence can be mistaken for improved test-time scaling. A practical replication should report per-complexity-bin accuracy, routing rate, verifier calibration, path count, evidence coverage, and end-to-end cost. This reveals whether selective scaling saves compute without silently denying hard cases the needed exploration.
应分别审计路由器和验证器。先衡量潜在复杂度分类器是否把真正困难的声明送往昂贵路径；再衡量验证器是否能从相同候选池中选出比多数投票更好的轨迹。比较选择策略时必须固定检索，否则改进的证据可能被误认为改进的测试时扩展。实际复现应报告每个复杂度分组的准确率、路由率、验证器校准、路径数、证据覆盖与端到端成本。这能揭示选择性扩展是否节省计算而又没有悄悄拒绝困难案例所需的探索。
